explication: billion-context is a context-compression proxy and agent integration layer. An agent sends model traffic through the proxy; the proxy processes the conversation with acp-kernel’s incremental compression, exposes model-invoked context tools, forwards requests to a compatible model API, and rewrites streaming responses. Client-specific adapters and launch/MITM support provide alternative ways to route traffic. Session state and content support long-lived conversations; a web interface exposes session and operational views. The README documents the core workflow and tools; sampled source confirms the loop, protocol adapters, configuration, and selected integrations, but not every subsystem’s wiring.
